# SheetJS Community Edition

Version: 0.20.3. Downloaded 17 October 2026 from the official SheetJS CDN. The browser build is unmodified. The converter loads this local file, never the CDN.

- Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
- Licence: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/LICENSE
- Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/
- Licence: Apache 2.0, preserved in `LICENSE.txt` and the build header.
- SHA-256 of `xlsx.full.min.js`: `cc015130aa8521e7f088f88898eba949ccdcbfb38df0bd129b44b7273c3a6f41`.
- SHA-256 of `LICENSE.txt`: `4d2a38ac35cda06a555c84074a819d413339cd3691b822cae50f8f322fe01f64`.

The library reads and writes Excel files using local buffers. The application does not invoke its filesystem, network or formula-evaluation integrations. Macro code is not retained for export. JSON and delimited-text processing use repository-owned code.
